annotations.title: Say a repeat is not the same issue

description: When Odin folded a later pentest's finding into this one as 'Reported again' but it is a different vulnerability, give it its own finding and keep the two apart. Only on an explicit user request. Requires write permission and acts as the API key creator, who must be a member or above. The earlier finding's status is not changed.

agentFindingId.description: The later report shown as 'Reported again' on this finding: its engine finding id (agentFindingId of the sighting).

findingId.description: Raw internal finding ID, useful when chaining from another tool.

identifier.description: Human-readable finding identifier such as "ODI-12". Preferred input.

name: split_finding_repeat
